backend/tests/test_caddy_assets.py: Skips unless TICO_TEST_CADDY names the pinned official Caddy binary.
backend/tests/test_caddy_container.py: Docker: runs the Caddy container. The caddy job runs it with -m slow whenever the map reaches it (CADDY_ROOTS).
backend/tests/test_caddy_supervisor.py: Downloads the pinned Caddy release with wget or curl and runs it.
backend/tests/test_databases.py: Docker: its PostgreSQL check runs in a throwaway container and skips without Docker.
backend/tests/test_e2e_cli.py: Contract test: the contracts job runs it whenever the map reaches it (CONTRACT_TESTS).
backend/tests/test_e2e_mcp.py: Contract test: the contracts job runs it whenever the map reaches it (CONTRACT_TESTS).
backend/tests/test_hermes_e2e.py: Its connector installs a launchd or systemd timer on the host, so it skips on a check machine.
backend/tests/test_litestream.py: Skips unless the checksum-pinned Litestream binary is installed.
backend/tests/test_mongodb.py: Docker: its MongoDB check runs in a throwaway container and skips without Docker.
backend/tests/test_native_recorder.py: Skips unless TICO_NATIVE_CLI names a built native CLI.
backend/tests/test_server_compose.py: Skips unless TICO_TEST_CADDY names the pinned official Caddy binary.
backend/tests/test_threads_e2e_runner.py: Skips unless a release tico-runner is built first or TICO_RUNNER_BIN names one; the queue builds neither.
e2e/tests/test_contract.py: Contract test: the contracts job runs it whenever the map reaches it (CONTRACT_TESTS).
runner_support/tests/test_conformance.py: About 490 s in one file, longer than a queue shard. The conformance job runs it for runner changes, and Release validation keeps it.
runner_support/tests/test_git_credential: Its Mac login-shell case skips without bash and zsh.
runner_support/tests/test_isolation_dock: Docker isolation: needs a Docker daemon and the runner image built from the candidate. Release validation runs it alone (scripts/release_checks.py ISOLATION_FILE).
runner_support/tests/test_old_runner_ske: Skips unless OLD_RUNNER_BINARY names a build of origin/main's runner, which no queue group builds.
scripts/tests/test_image_pins.py: Asks PyPI over the network for each pinned wheel.
scripts/tests/test_release_checks.py: Needs the runner image built from the candidate (Docker).
setup/tests/test_install_sh.py: Runs the installer in real distro containers over the network; skips without Docker.
setup/tests/test_tunnel.py: Runs the pinned cloudflared image with Docker; skips when that image is not on the machine.
